The knob is very loose and falls off unlike the Kenmore 9915 filter which fits the knob very tight and snaps into place. My Kenmore refrigerator takes a 9915 Kenmore water filter. When I received the Tier 1 filter, the filters carried the part number of RWF 1021. It was similar to the original water filter in size, length, and top connection. Replacement took less that 1 minute. Simply insert the filter and turn it one quarter of a turn to the right.

I cannot get these filters out of my Whirlpool fridge without the turn knob breaking off and leaving the water filter stuck in the fridge. A contractor almost flooded my kitchen by drilling holes in the last one to get it out. I tried to get it out again and the knob broke off again and the filter is stuck inside again. I have 2 unused filters if anyone wants them, the only real solution is to buy a new fridge with a different kind of filter as I don't think Whirlpool makes it anymore? That's the only reason I bought these.

In an attempt to save some money on a filter, I bought this one from Amazon instead of the $40 version I usually buy at Sears for my Kenmore refrigerator. The filter fit fine and appeared physically to be the same as the Kenmore brand I usually buy. However, the difference was apparent. After running more than a gallon of water through the system after the filter change (standard practice), the water had a bitter taste that never subsided. This was never an issue with the Kenmore filters that basically remove all of the taste from the water. My advice, stay away from this filter.

Summary: I recommend this product on cleanliness, packaging, water quality, and price.

This filter IS NOT a direct replacement. It is 3/4 inch shorter than the old filter. The ears that lock the filter in has sharp corners the old one rounded corners. It would not turn to lock in. Called tier filters and they refunded my money and told me to keep the filters. I am a tinkerman so I proceeded to round off the corners so it matched the old one. It went in and turned to lock. Only problem was the cap to match the grill could not be used as now the filter is recessed 3/4 of an inch. Called tier again and shared my information and guess what, they knew they had a problem. Did I mention the old filter was also a tier filter? The manufacturer messed this up and know one caught it and sounds like they don't care as they are still being sold as a perfect replacement. Their advice to me was go buy a filter from Sears or whirlpool! Buyer beware!
